home.title: Game Hub
home.subtitle: Pick a game to play. Made by the Thomas Family (with some help from AI).
home.tip: Tip: bookmark /sudoku to jump straight into Sudoku.

sudoku.name: Sudoku
sudoku.description: Classic 9×9 puzzle with timer and leaderboard.
sudoku.title: Sudoku
sudoku.subtitle: Challenge your mind with this classic puzzle game
sudoku.select_difficulty: Select difficulty to start a new game
sudoku.no_scores: No scores yet. Complete a puzzle to get on the board!
sudoku.instruction_1: Fill the 9×9 grid so that each row, column, and 3×3 box contains digits 1-9
sudoku.instruction_2: Click on a cell and type a number to fill it (1-9)
sudoku.instruction_3: Press 0 or Backspace to clear a cell
sudoku.instruction_4: Click "Check" to validate your solution when complete

dots_and_boxes.name: Dots and Boxes
dots_and_boxes.description: Draw lines, complete boxes, and rack up points.
dots_and_boxes.title: Dots and Boxes
dots_and_boxes.subtitle: Two players take turns drawing lines. Complete a box to score and play again.
dots_and_boxes.click_to_draw: Click near a segment to draw it.
dots_and_boxes.tip: Tip: aim near a gap between two dots. Completing a box gives you another turn.
dots_and_boxes.mobile_tip: Tip: tap near a gap between two dots. Completing a box gives you another turn.
dots_and_boxes.rule_2: Finish a box to claim it.
dots_and_boxes.rule_3: If you claim a box, you play again.
dots_and_boxes.rule_4: Game ends when all boxes are claimed.

connect_four.name: Connect Four
connect_four.description: Drop pieces and get four in a row to win.
connect_four.title: Connect Four
connect_four.subtitle: Drop pieces and get four in a row to win.
connect_four.rule_1: Take turns dropping pieces into columns.
connect_four.rule_2: Get four pieces in a row to win.

connect_four_3d.name: Connect Four 3D
connect_four_3d.description: Rotate a 4×4×4 board and connect four in any 3D direction.
connect_four_3d.title: Connect Four 3D
connect_four_3d.subtitle: Tap a top cell to drop, drag to rotate, and connect four in any direction.
connect_four_3d.rule_2: Drag with mouse or finger to rotate the 3D board.
connect_four_3d.rule_3: Use Roll buttons (or Shift+drag / Q and E) for the third axis.
connect_four_3d.rule_4: Tap or click a top cell to drop your piece.
connect_four_3d.rule_5: Connect 4 in any straight 3D direction to win.
connect_four_3d.hint_drag_tap: Drag to rotate. Tap or click a top cell to drop.
connect_four_3d.rotate_clearer: Rotate to a clearer angle and tap a top cell.
connect_four_3d.column_full: Column is full. Try another top cell.
connect_four_3d.start_new_or_undo: Start a new game or undo the last move.
connect_four_3d.drag_to_rotate_keep: Drag to rotate and keep playing.
connect_four_3d.tap_top_cell: Tap or click a top cell to drop your piece.

minesweeper.name: Minesweeper
minesweeper.title: Minesweeper
minesweeper.subtitle: Find all the mines without detonating any.
minesweeper.click_instructions: Left-click to reveal, right-click to flag.

rules.title: Rules
rules.win: Reveal all non-mine cells to win.
rules.lose: Hit a mine and you lose!

robot_runner.name: Robot Runner
robot_runner.description: One-player endless runner. Press Space or tap to jump over obstacles.

math_lanes.name: Math Lanes
math_lanes.description: Pick left or right to solve simple math and power up before obstacles hit you.

towers_of_hanoi.name: Towers of Hanoi
towers_of_hanoi.description: Classic puzzle with three towers and disks.
towers_of_hanoi.title: Towers of Hanoi
towers_of_hanoi.subtitle: Move all disks from the left tower to the right tower. Only one disk can be moved at a time, and a larger disk cannot be placed on a smaller one.
towers_of_hanoi.click_select_disk: Click on a disk to select it
towers_of_hanoi.drag_or_click: Drag a disk or click to select it
towers_of_hanoi.click_tower_move: Click on a tower to move it there
towers_of_hanoi.only_top_disk: You can only move the top disk
towers_of_hanoi.larger_on_smaller: Cannot place a larger disk on a smaller one
towers_of_hanoi.rule_1: Only one disk can be moved at a time
towers_of_hanoi.rule_2: A disk can only be placed on an empty tower or on a larger disk
towers_of_hanoi.rule_3: All disks must end up on the rightmost tower
towers_of_hanoi.rule_4: Goal: Move the entire stack from left to right
towers_of_hanoi.instructions_desktop: Drag a disk to move it, or click to select and then click a tower.
towers_of_hanoi.instructions_mobile: Drag a disk to move it, or tap to select and then tap a tower.
towers_of_hanoi.no_scores: No scores yet. Complete a puzzle to get on the board!
towers_of_hanoi.enter_name: 🎉 Congratulations! Enter your name for the leaderboard:

chess.name: Chess
chess.title: Chess
chess.subtitle: Classic strategy game with move highlighting.
chess.rule_2: Click a piece to select it, then click destination.
chess.rule_3: Capture enemy pieces by landing on them.

checkers.name: Checkers
checkers.title: Checkers
checkers.subtitle: Take turns moving diagonally and capture all opposing pieces.
checkers.select_piece: Select a piece to see possible moves.
checkers.forced_capture: A capture is available. You must capture.
checkers.keep_jumping: Keep jumping with the same piece!
checkers.crowned: King me! This piece is now a king.
checkers.rule_2: Jump over opponent pieces to capture them.
checkers.rule_3: If a capture is available, you must take it.
checkers.rule_4: Reach the far side to become a king.
checkers.rule_5: Win by capturing all enemy pieces or blocking all moves.

kenken.name: KenKen
kenken.title: KenKen
kenken.subtitle: Fill the grid with numbers following the arithmetic rules.
kenken.rule_1: Fill each row and column with unique numbers.
kenken.rule_2: Cages show arithmetic operations that must equal the target.
kenken.rule_4: Single cells contain their own value.
kenken.rule_5: Use numbers 1 through N where N is the grid size.

solitaire.name: Solitaire
solitaire.description: Jump over marbles to remove them.
solitaire.title: Solitaire
solitaire.subtitle: Jump over marbles to remove them from the board.
solitaire.rule_1: Click a marble to select it.
solitaire.rule_2: Click an empty hole to jump over an adjacent marble.
solitaire.rule_3: The jumped marble is removed from the board.
solitaire.rule_4: Continue until only one marble remains.

gems.name: Gems
gems.description: Match colorful gems, create specials, and chain combos.
gems.title: Gems
gems.subtitle: Swap adjacent gems to make matches and trigger special powers.
gems.special_fan: Fan (🪭): create a 2×2 square match to spawn a fan. Click it or move it to destroy random gems.
gems.rule_1: Swap two adjacent gems by clicking or dragging.
gems.rule_2: Match 3 or more gems in a row or column to clear them.
gems.rule_3: Bomb gems explode nearby cells for bonus points.
gems.rule_4: Create a 2×2 square of the same gem to generate a fan.
gems.rule_5: Fans activate when clicked or moved, destroying random gems.
gems.rule_6: Cascades can create chain reactions and boost your score.
gems.rule_7: Keep matching to level up and survive longer.
gems.msg_select_swap: Select a gem to swap with
gems.msg_adjacent_only: Gems must be adjacent to swap!
gems.msg_no_match: No matches found! Try a different swap.
gems.msg_reset_confirm: Reset all scores and start a new game?

common.click_to_place: Click a square to place your mark.
common.keyboard_help: Keyboard: Use Tab/Shift+Tab to focus a cell, then press Enter/Space to play.
common.first_to_three: First to get 3 in a row wins.
common.draw_if_full: If all squares fill with no winner: draw.
